exposure: Children with high and stable weight and length trajectory
Children with lower weight and length trajectory
cohort: Children born in public health services in Colombo-PR, Brazil, between 2018 and 2022
finding: Conditions during pregnancy and childbirth can impact growth patterns in the first two years of life.
mod_finding: The probability of belonging to the lower weight gain group was associated with cesarean delivery, while the probability of belonging to the lower length gain group was also associated with cesarean delivery.
